Whenever we tell people that this is kind of our thing, they don't really seem to get it. So, I'll try to explain my reasoning the best I can.

My wife and I absolutely adore Hard Rock Cafe, and whenever we visit a new city (which isn't that common), we have to go to it if they have one. You see, we look at it as two different experiences in one. Firstly, you are at a restaurant, and the food is great. Secondly, it's like a museum, too. They have great food and you get to walk around and look at tons of rock n' roll memorabilia. To have both of these at the same time is crazy awesome. People often think it's very gimmicky, but we just don't think that's the case. Planet Hollywood is pretty gimmicky, and the reason it's not as good is because great movie props are so hard to come by, and there are a lot of collectors. So, the restaurants never have anything really good. Hard Rock Cafe is different. If you go to one in a certain city, they often (not always, but frequently) dedicate them to people from the area, which really makes each one unique if you visit a lot of them. And every one always has at least a few items from major artists. Since it's a rarity for us to go to one, it becomes a very special evening.

Our finest experience was at the one in Orlando, FL (which I believe is the biggest one). Our waitress was gracious enough to sit us in "the CBGB room." They literally had the walls from the music club hanging on the walls in this room. It was surreal. The plaques next to them were explaining how these were the interior walls that had been acquired when it closed and they still had like syringes inside of them and stuff like that.

If you aren't familiar: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CBGB

What will I have? Hmmm, I love the Tupelo Chicken Tenders, with french fries. Man, I wish they had Coca-Cola products instead of Pepsi, but I'll take a Pepsi. I guess. A lot of ice, please. No dessert. We'll go out to Ben & Jerry's or Baskin Robbins afterwards.

Incidentally, we have plans to go to one this Sunday when we are out of town. Unfortunately, it's one we've been to before. But, hey, that's okay. Maybe they'll have new stuff to look at!
